title: 第一卷 第9章 本尊不哭第一卷 第10章 云爻师叔祖
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
负责通传的弟子听见这些话，忍不住翻了个白眼——一个下品灵根小屁孩吹嘘自己的话，就这群小孩儿会当真。
密阁内。
到场的人，比洛还真想象中的还要多。
丹红长老和苏明月也在。
宫裙中年美妇冷着脸坐在一旁，苏明月依偎在她怀中，探出半个头。她眼睛红彤彤的一脸委屈，看上去像只受了欺负的小兔子。
师尊衡阳子坐在正中。
十年不见，他看着她时，眼神里不是失而复得的喜悦，而是一种复杂的、带着为难的神情。
大师兄林逸尘站在师尊身侧，笑容温和。
二师兄、三师兄、四师兄、五师兄依次站着，只是这些她想了十年、念了十年的脸，此刻全都在场，却没有一个人朝她走来。
洛还真望着这一切，满腔热切哗啦一声浇了个透心凉。
本尊……
好像，不受欢迎？
下一刻，苏明月站了起来。
她走到洛还真面前，一下子红了眼眶，眼泪扑簌簌往下掉。
“对不起……占了你这么多年。我不应该活下来，或许当年死了才是该有的结局。我把身份还给你，我走。”
苏明月哭得浑身发抖，活像是受了欺负一般。
“胡说八道！”丹红长老历呵一声，维护道，“什么真的假的，我用灵药把你从鬼门关拽回来，十年如一日照顾你的身体，在我眼里就你一个！”
比起曾经的天才洛还真。
体贴又乖巧，一直被自己精心照顾长大的苏明月，才是她偏心的孩子。
苏明月泪水更汹涌。

而丹红长老见状越发心疼，看洛还真的眼神更是充满厌恶。
洛还真瞪大小嘴巴，然后赶紧后退两步，像是躲避瘟疫，“本尊什么都没做，本尊没有欺负她，是她自己哭的！”
苏明月咬唇摇头，“对。是、是我的错。你们不要怨真真师、师姐……”
众人越发心疼起她的柔弱善良。
林逸尘轻叹一声，上前两步，蹲下来与洛还真平视，“小师妹，，先这么叫你吧。”
“你说你是洛还真，我愿意相信你。但明月在宗门十年，体弱多病，灵根残损，离开宗门就是个死。而你在万魔窟都能活十年，你一定能理解的，对不对？”
洛还真瞪大眼睛。
像是听见了什么奇怪的话。
她想把这个顶替自己的假货揍进泥里摩擦摩擦再摩擦。
但是大师兄竟然让她理解假货？
洛还真：“本尊不理解！”
林逸尘自责地解释：“意思就是，明月她也是受害者。是大师兄认错了人将她带回宗门，被当成真真养了十年，真真倒也不必如此敌视明月。”
洛还真着急地道：“可是她在入门测试时想害本尊！”
“真真！”雷子越打断洛还真的话，急切道：“明月她只是太害怕失去了，不是故意想伤害你！”
洛还真大声道：“这本就不是属于她的东西！就连她用的名字，都是盗用本尊的！”
雷子越蹲下来，握住洛还真的肩，手在发抖，“真真，你改个名字行不行？我保证对你好，比谁都好。但真……明月她受不了这个刺激，她太弱了。你不一样，你坚强……”
丹红长老一脸赞同地附和：“是的，这孩子能活着回来确实不简单，但也仅此而已。她的灵根已残，成为最低劣的下品灵根，再加上境界低微，即便认回身份，也担不起‘洛还真’三个字的分量了。”
苏明月从丹红长老怀里抬起头，泪眼婆娑地望向她。
洛还真好难受。
content_en:
When the disciple in charge of communication heard these words, he couldn't help but roll his eyes - only this group of kids would take his words seriously when a brat with a low-grade spiritual root brags.
Inside the secret pavilion.
There were more people present than Luo Huazhen had imagined.
Elder Danhong and Su Mingyue were also there.
The beautiful middle-aged woman in the palace dress sat aside with a cold expression. Su Mingyue nestled in her arms and stuck out half of her head. Her eyes were red and she looked aggrieved, looking like a bullied little rabbit.
Master Hengyangzi is sitting in the middle.
After not seeing each other for ten years, when he looked at her, the look in his eyes was not the joy of regaining her, but a complicated and embarrassed look.
Senior brother Lin Yichen stood beside his master with a gentle smile.
The second senior brother, the third senior brother, the fourth senior brother, and the fifth senior brother were standing in turn, but these faces that she had thought about and read about for ten years were all present at the moment, but no one was walking towards her.
Luo Huai really looked at all this, his heart filled with enthusiasm and he felt a chill in his heart.
I...
Like, not welcome?
The next moment, Su Mingyue stood up.
She walked up to Luo Huanzhen, her eyes suddenly turned red, and tears fell down.
"I'm sorry...I've occupied you for so many years. I shouldn't have survived. Maybe I should have died back then. I'll return my identity to you and I'll leave."
Su Mingyue cried so hard that she was shaking all over, as if she had been bullied.
"Nonsense!" Elder Danhong exclaimed and defended, "What's true or false? I used the elixir to drag you back from hell and took care of your body for ten years. In my eyes, you are the only one!"
It's truer than the former genius Luo.
Su Mingyue, who was considerate and well-behaved and had been carefully taken care of by her, was her preferred child.
Su Mingyue's tears became more intense.
Elder Dan Hong felt even more distressed when he saw this, and his eyes when looking at Luo Huanzhen were filled with disgust.
Luo really stared, then quickly took two steps back, as if to avoid the plague, "I didn't do anything, I didn't bully her, she cried on her own!"
Su Mingyue bit her lip and shook her head, "Yes. It's my fault. Don't blame Master Zhenzhen and Senior Sister..."
Everyone felt more and more sorry for her weakness and kindness.
Lin Yichen sighed softly, took two steps forward, squatted down and looked at Luo Huanzhen at eye level, "Little junior sister, let me call you that for now."
"You said you are Luo Huanzhen, and I am willing to believe you. But Mingyue has been in the sect for ten years. She is frail and sick, and her spiritual roots are damaged. Leaving the sect means death. And you can live ten years in the Ten Thousand Demons Cave. You must understand, right?"
Luo's eyes really widened.
It seemed like I heard something strange.
She wanted to beat the fake that was replacing her into the mud and rub it again and again.
But the elder brother actually asked her to understand fakes?
Luo Huanzhen: "I don't understand!"
Lin Yichen explained with self-blame: "The meaning is that Mingyue is also a victim. It was the senior brother who took her back to the sect after admitting the wrong person. She was raised as Zhenzhen for ten years. Zhenzhen does not need to be so hostile to Mingyue."
Luo Huai said anxiously: "But she wanted to harm me during the entry test!"
"It's true!" Lei Ziyue interrupted Luo Huanzhen's words and said urgently: "Mingyue is just too afraid of losing. She didn't mean to hurt you!"
Luo Huazhen said loudly: "This does not belong to her! Even the name she used was stolen from me!"
Lei Ziyue squatted down and held Luo Huanzhen's shoulders, his hands trembling, "Zhenzhen, can you change your name? I promise to treat you well, better than anyone else. But really... Mingyue can't stand this stimulation, she is too weak. You are different, you are strong..."
Elder Dan Hong agreed with his face: "Yes, it is indeed not easy for this child to come back alive, but that's all. Her spiritual roots are disabled and have become the lowest-grade spiritual roots. In addition, her realm is low. Even if she recognizes her identity, she cannot bear the weight of the word 'Luo Huanzhen'."
Su Mingyue raised her head from Elder Danhong's arms with tears in her eyes.Looking at her sadly.
Luo felt really uncomfortable.
